title: taraxacum dens-leonis subsp. gymnanthum
intro: Taraxacum dens-leonis subsp. gymnanthum, commonly known as the Lion's Spur Dandelion, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting liver function due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Taraxacum dens-leonis subsp. gymnanthum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
